attestations.text: CH'IEN T'ang 錢塘 (T. 學淵, 禹美, H. 溉亭), 1735–1790, scholar, native of Chia-ting, Kiangsu, was a relative of Ch'ien Ta-hsin [q. v.]. He obtained his chü-jên degree in 1779 and his chin-shih degree in 1780 with appointment as director of schools of Chiang-ning (Nanking).
